settings.heading: Industry Pain Points and Operational Risks

settings.text: The commercial transport industry faces significant challenges related to safety, operational efficiency, compliance, and asset integrity. These pain points often increase liability and operational costs;

settings.heading: Risk of Impaired Driving & Liability (Safety)
settings.text:
• Ensuring drivers operate vehicles responsibly requires proactive measures, as alcohol interlocks are highly effective in reducing the risk of drunk driving and saving lives. Drink driving incidents often result in licence disqualifications, fines, and severe cases, jail time.
  • Even when drivers do not feel intoxicated, their Blood Alcohol Concentration (BAC) readings may indicate otherwise.

settings.heading: Inefficient Fleet Management and Productivity
settings.text:
• Without 24-hour a day, real-time monitoring, fleets lack insights into time spent with customers and at specific locations.
  • Managing driver accountability regarding crucial metrics like Harsh Braking, Acceleration, Speeding, and Idling can be difficult.

settings.heading: Unforeseen Vehicle Downtime (Maintenance)
settings.text: Taking the guesswork out of asset management and maintenance scheduling is a consistent challenge. Failing to monitor vehicle health can lead to high costs and cut into business expenses.

settings.heading: Compliance and Data Reporting Burden
settings.text: Transport businesses must adhere to strict compliance obligations and build defensible testing programmes against drug and alcohol misuse. Reporting requires reliable, certified data.

settings.title: The Integrated Solution: ALX3000 Interlock + FleetMAX+ Telematics

settings.text:
WHG and Andatech have partnered to deliver an interconnected solution that enhances fleet efficiency and safety by combining reliable alcohol testing technology with premier fleet management capabilities.


The solution integrates the Andatech ALX3000 Car Ignition Interlock Breathalyser with the WHG FleetMAX+ system.

settings.heading: The Andatech ALX3000 Interlock is designed for voluntary personal or company use. It addresses safety and accountability pain points by:
settings.text:
• Preventing Intoxicated Driving: The system is connected to the vehicle's ignition and requires a breath sample before the car can start. It acts as a smart interlock system, preventing the engine start when alcohol is detected.
  • Ensuring Continued Sobriety: An optional feature of rolling retest is available to ensure no alcohol is consumed after the first successful test. This retest occurs only once during the drive and can be set to occur 5–60 minutes after the engine is started.
  • Voluntary Control: For voluntary use, the BAC limit can be set by the company or driver.
  • Robust Data Storage: It offers large internal memory and can record up to 500,000 events or test logs. This data is crucial for monitoring purposes.
  • Certified Assurance: The ALX3000 is approved and certified (EN 50436-1&2: 2014, E-MARK(EMC), IATF 16949: 2016), demonstrating proven accuracy.
  • Operational Reliability: It features quick operation, delivering results in 10 seconds, with a recovery time of 30 seconds after a positive test. It works reliably in all climates, operating in temperatures from 40°C up to 85°C.

settings.heading: The WHG FleetMAX+ Telematics system is a premier management tool that integrates essential fleet data, solving efficiency and maintenance pain points:
settings.text:
• Increased Productivity and Efficiency: Provides enhanced timesheet reporting with automated system alerts. It delivers arrival and departure records and offers insights through 24-hour a day, real-time monitoring.
  • Proactive Maintenance: Enables improved Vehicle Maintenance through features like service reminders, vehicle health monitoring, battery status, and fault codes. The dashboard provides immediate alerts, such as braking maintenance due in 500km or TPMS due yesterday.
  • Driver Monitoring: Provides alerts for critical driver behaviours, including Harsh Braking, Acceleration, Speeding, and Idling.
  • Security and Diagnostics: Supports remote diagnostics and early theft warning.
  • Regulatory Compliance: FleetMAX+ is RIMS, TMA, and Smart OBM Certified & Compliant. The system is also IoT Ready.

settings.heading: Andatech ALX3000 Car Ignition Interlock Breathalyser

settings.text:
• Smart Interlock System: Requires a breath sample before the car can start, preventing engine start when alcohol is detected.
  • Certified Accuracy: Approved and certified (EN 50436-1&2: 2014, E-MARK(EMC), IATF 16949: 2016) for proven accuracy.
  • Voluntary Use: Designed for voluntary personal or company use. For voluntary interlocks, the BAC limit can be set by the company or driver.
  • Data Storage: Records up to 500,000 eventsor test logs.
  • Rolling Retest (Optional): Ensures no alcohol is consumed during the drive, occurring only once, 5–60 minutes after the engine is started.
  • All-Climate Reliability: Works reliably in temperatures from -40°C up to 85°C.

settings.heading: The partnership provides Certified Assurance for compliance while driving efficiency through interconnected technology.

settings.text:
• Maximized Safety: Mandatory alcohol checks are seamlessly integrated with driver monitoring metrics, creating a complete safety profile.
  • Streamlined Compliance: Alcohol test logs (up to 500,000 records) are combined with telematics data, providing comprehensive Occupational Health & Safety Reporting.
  • Optimised Operations: Fleet managers gain real-time visibility and improved productivity by linking vehicle status, maintenance needs, and driver behaviour to the critical safety measure of alcohol compliance.

settings.heading: Think of the integrated solution as a high-tech safety padlock for your vehicle fleet.

settings.text: The Andatech ALX3000 Interlock is the specific key that only works if the driver is sober, protecting the vehicle from starting while impaired. The WHG FleetMAX+ Telematics system is the security control room that records every attempt to use the key, monitors the health of the padlock, tracks where the vehicle goes, and alerts management if the vehicle is being operated poorly or needs maintenance. By linking the key directly to the control room, you ensure compliance and efficiency are managed simultaneously.
